source_label: The Age When You Began the Menarche
value_label_status: official questionnaire and Codebook identify the age-response component; no frequencies copied
mapping_status: wave-specific life-course exposure candidate; official item and age component reviewed; analysis eligibility and cross-wave equivalence not approved
value_semantics: Age in years only when the respondent used the age response component; the calendar-year response is a separate field.
caveat: Female-only. The questionnaire routes DA026–DA028 to new respondents; DA026_1 is the separate year component and is not converted to age. In 2018 the parent item also has a separate never-menstruated response; do not encode it as an age. Returning respondents are not generally re-asked this retrospective item. Preserve eligible denominator and recall limitations; no cross-wave equivalence is established.

caveat: Female-only and conditional on the menopause branch. DA028 is asked only after a yes response to DA027 and an eligible route; DA028_1 is a separate year component and is not converted to age.
